title: YouCoded name and icons — round 5, fewer and deeper

steps.path: Website header, help pages, marketing — everywhere "YouCoded" is written
steps.headline: Which ways of writing the name do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Each is shown big on today's website, in the header, in three other themes, and on a plain help page.

variants.label: N1 Letters built from the mascot
variants.summary: Hand-drawn letters: every round letter is the mascot's rounded-square body. Unique to us; the mascot is in the shapes, not pasted in.

variants.label: N2 "You" wears your theme
variants.summary: "Coded" never changes; "You" takes the font and colour of your theme. The name shows off what the app does.

variants.label: N3 The cursor
variants.summary: The site's label font, ending in a block cursor with the mascot's legs. Strongest on technical pages.

variants.label: N4 Sticker, with the "o" that stands
variants.summary: Your W6 + L3 picks, redone: the mascot-"o" is a proper letter first, legs hanging below like the "y" tail.

variants.label: N5 Matches the headline
variants.summary: The website's big-headline lettering with your W11 fade on "You". Safest: already matches the site.

variants.label: N6 The name is the body
variants.summary: "you / coded" stacked inside the mascot's body. A badge, sticker or profile picture as much as a name.

steps.path: Taskbar, Mac dock, browser tab, Mac menu bar / Linux tray
steps.headline: Which app icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Each board shows it at true size on a Windows taskbar, a Mac dock, a browser tab and a one-colour menu bar, next to today's icon, and wearing five themes.

variants.label: I1 Your wallpaper, our shape
variants.summary: Tile shows your theme's scenery; the mascot is a dark cut-out in front. Changes with every theme.

variants.label: I2 The icon is the mascot
variants.summary: No tile: the mascot's outline is the icon. The clearest when small, and unlike anything else on a taskbar.

variants.label: I3 The cursor
variants.summary: Dark screen, prompt arrow, a cursor that is the mascot. Pairs with name N3.

variants.label: I4 Just the squint
variants.summary: The "> <" face plus a small smile, as a symbol. Most abstract; boldest when tiny.

variants.label: I5 Peeking
variants.summary: The mascot climbing up from the bottom edge of a night-sky tile. Most "cute character".

steps.headline: Which installer icons do you like? Pick as many as you want.
steps.notice: Shown in a Downloads folder next to ordinary files, and beside today's installer icon at 96, 32 and 16 pixels.

variants.label: D1 Arriving in a box
variants.summary: The mascot pops out of an opened parcel, waving. The friendliest file in the folder.

variants.label: D2 App icon + download badge
variants.summary: Whichever app icon wins, with a green download badge. The conventional, instantly-understood choice.

variants.label: D3 Dropping in
variants.summary: The mascot floats down under a striped parachute: "download", literally.
